summary.en: Pi-Desktop on magpie's Agents page: magpie keeps a Pi-Desktop plugin folder that adds it as a model provider, with its current models and their thinking levels. Pi-Desktop picks up model changes when it starts.
summary.zh: 把 Pi-Desktop 加到 magpie 的 Agent 页：magpie 维护一个 Pi-Desktop 插件文件夹，把自己加为模型服务，带上当前模型和推理等级；模型有变化时，Pi-Desktop 重启后生效。
